_about: Darrow's finished looks, for the Wardrobe (darrow/wardrobe.html). Each: id, name, made (the date it was filed), image (under saga/art/, in looks/), alt (what the picture shows), values (one option id per category of engine/wardrobe.json) and details (the small touches typed in the Forge, or empty). A look shows once every piece it wears is open; the newest shown is his current look, at the head of his Reckoning. Filed from the Look line the Forge gives with the picture.

looks.name: The Drove Road
looks.alt: Ser Darrow, full length against a dark glow, laughing: a few days' stubble, the grey wool blanket round his shoulders as a hooded cloak over a linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, brown trousers, a leather belt and tall worn boots.
